# Analyze the relationship between introduction pathways and mrt in invasion_success dataset
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Check the distribution of mrt across different introduction pathways
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='mrt', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Distribution of Minimum Residence Time (mrt) by Introduction Pathway')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Minimum Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.show()

from scipy.stats import kruskal
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Perform Kruskal-Wallis test to compare mrt across introduction pathways
kruskal_result = kruskal(
    invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == 'Gardening']['mrt'],
    invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == 'AgriForest']['mrt'],
    invasion_success[invasion_success['intro.pathway'] == 'Unintentional']['mrt']
)
kruskal_result

# Perform linear regression to examine the relationship between mrt and number of invaded plots
X = invasion_success[['mrt']]
y = invasion_success['number.of.invaded.plots']

X = sm.add_constant(X)
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
model.summary()
